feedback_timing.protocol: each outcome is released to the FinMem-style, MemRL-style and Reflexion agents only after its 20-session window
feedback_timing.replay: run_cb_delayfix.py replayed the FinMem-style, MemRL-style and Reflexion chains of the logged run under this protocol; a logged decision whose prompt is unchanged is kept, any other decision (and the Reflexion note written after it) is drawn anew
